styleSelection.reason: The winding pale track and bright open slopes read through connected green washes; sparse dry black branch gestures explain the woodland without outlining every crown.

HILLS.foreground-meadow.reason: The sunlit yellow-green slopes and warm pale track need distinct transparent value planes and dry terrain edges; narrow grass detail is omitted, with ink reserved for neighboring trunks.

families.referenceCue: Upper-left distant woodland: grey olive crown tops over a cool blue-grey connected foundation, quieter than the central trees. Wash first; dry shadow glaze; no individual distant leaves.
Upper-right sunlit yellow-green hillside and pale descending track. Broad transparent wash with lost internal grass edges; preserve the light track as a pale warm painted plane.
Diagonal sunlit grass beside the upper-left path. A connected pale yellow-green wash; dry restrained olive terrain shadows; the road has irregular light edges.
Main belt of overlapping cool blue-green and olive trees. Connected underwash, full dry, then coherent shadow groups crossing crowns and trunks, retaining warm crown-top lights.
Dark near trees along the left side, including the forked tree beside the central bend. Mixed-dark wash and dry shadow glaze; the few narrow trunks and forks belong to selective black ink.
Large luminous yellow-green slope to the right of the central path. One connected wash, gentle olive turning shadow on fully dry paint; grass stays a value plane with only broken edge texture.

The warm cream track bends out of the central woodland and descends toward the lower edge. Pale ochre wash, held near-paper lights, tiny dry accents only where a tree shadow meets it; no continuous pen outline.
Near right-hand trees interrupting the meadow. Cool connected wash followed by dry dark interiors, broken lit crown rims and a few tapering trunk marks.
Foreground olive foliage across the foot of the pale track. Coherent mid-value wash with dry shadow pockets; leave small target-supported light interruptions.
